Class OpenApiViewConfig

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.openapi.view.OpenApiViewConfig
public final class OpenApiViewConfig extends Object
OpenApi view configuration for Swagger UI, ReDoc, OpenAPI Explorer, Scalar and RapiDoc. By default, no views are enabled.
Author:
croudet
